prompt: Photograph a figure at a street-market stall on a grey Saturday, taken on a Canon AE-1 at eye level from behind a crate of apples that blurs the near foreground, framed off-centre. He stands behind the stall holding up a single potato to the camera like evidence. His whole head is in a cream knitted balaclava with no eye or mouth holes; a thin black ring is stitched around the face, and high inside it, over one eye, a small red triangle with rounded corners. A black roll-neck, a green market-trader's apron over a black fleece, black woollen fingerless gloves worn over black liner gloves so no skin shows. A battered portable television sits among the vegetables showing a picture of a politician at a podium. Flat overcast daylight, no sun, muted cool colour; shoppers blurred behind. Kodak Gold 200, visible grain. Thanks.
